summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on technical issues regarding the application of demographic data within analytics queries. Specifically, a problem was identified where demographic filters (like gender) were not correctly applied or accounted for in calculations, even though the raw data seemed to pass through the necessary fields.

Later, the conversation shifted to infrastructure and data storage capacity. It was noted that there is an immediate concern about running out of space across development environments due to large session data volumes. The team discussed moving older data (September) to S3 to free up space in the primary database.
decisions: Move September session data to S3 storage.
action_items: Investigate why demographic filters are not correctly applied in calculations within AE/analytics queries.
